answer: Every identity lives on one island with its own prism: each task is refracted into three linked outputs — plan, action, and audit — each embedding a hash of the other two, so they must be produced together by one coherent mind. Sparrow scouts arrive unannounced and demand a fresh refracted triple within seconds. Clones sharing one mind can only fake one output at a time and fail the cross-link; every extra island needs its own full-time operator, so fake costs grow faster than fake count.
